description: You are a web developer performing a pre-deployment security assessment of competitor developer platforms. Using Firefox DevTools (Network tab, Response Headers), audit the HTTP security headers of exactly these 5 websites: github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org, npmjs.com, and pypi.org. For each site, open DevTools (F12), go to the Network tab, navigate to the site, and inspect the response headers of the main page request. Record the actual header values (not just presence) for: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy (or Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only), X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options (or any frame-ancestors CSP directive). Create a JSON audit report at ~/Documents/security_audit_report.json. The JSON must have one top-level key per site (use the domain name as key), and each entry must contain at least 3 header fields with their actual string values. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
